summary: Enable patients to view appointment details via magic link without account creation. Implements token-based access with 48hr TTL, ICS calendar generation, and employer share workflow.

phases.name: Database Schema
phases.description: Add appointmentTokens table to Convex schema with required indexes

subtasks.description: Add appointmentTokens table to convex/schema.ts with tokenHash, appointmentId, patientId, createdAt, expiresAt, viewedAt, invalidated fields and 3 indexes (by_token, by_appointment, by_expiry)
acceptanceCriteria: appointmentTokens table defined with all 7 fields

phases.gateCondition: npm run typecheck passes with new schema

phases.name: Backend Token Module
phases.description: Create token generation, validation, and ICS calendar utilities

subtasks.description: Create convex/appointmentTokens.ts with: generate mutation (creates SHA-256 hashed token, 48hr TTL, audit logging), validateAndGetAppointment query (returns appointment with patient/doctor/type details), markViewed mutation, invalidateForAppointment internal mutation, hashToken utility
acceptanceCriteria: generate mutation creates token with SHA-256 hash
validateAndGetAppointment returns full appointment details for valid token
validateAndGetAppointment returns error for invalid/expired tokens
invalidateForAppointment sets invalidated=true for all appointment tokens
Audit log entry created on token generation

subtasks.description: Create convex/lib/icsGenerator.ts with generateICS function producing RFC 5545 compliant calendar files with VCALENDAR, VEVENT, VALARM (1 day and 1 hour reminders)
acceptanceCriteria: VEVENT has UID, DTSTART, DTEND, SUMMARY, DESCRIPTION, LOCATION
Two VALARM reminders (1 day, 1 hour before)

phases.gateCondition: Both files created, typecheck passes, generate mutation can be called via Convex CLI

phases.name: HTTP Calendar Endpoint
phases.description: Add public HTTP route for ICS file download

subtasks.description: Add /calendar/:token GET route to convex/http.ts that validates token, fetches appointment data, generates ICS using icsGenerator, returns with Content-Type text/calendar and Content-Disposition attachment header
acceptanceCriteria: Returns 200 with ICS content for valid token

phases.gateCondition: HTTP route deployed, curl to /calendar/{valid-token} returns ICS file

phases.name: Patient View Page
phases.description: Create public appointment view page and add routing

subtasks.description: Create src/pages/patient/ViewAppointment.tsx with: loading state (spinner), error state (red X, helpful message, home link), success state (appointment card with date/time/doctor/type/status/zoom link, Add to Calendar button, Print button). Uses useQuery for validateAndGetAppointment, useMutation for markViewed on mount.
acceptanceCriteria: Invalid token shows error card with XCircle icon
Valid token shows appointment details card
Date formatted as weekday, day month year
Status badge with correct color (pending=yellow, confirmed=blue, completed=green, cancelled=red)
Zoom link section visible when doctor has zoomPersonalLink
Add to Calendar button links to /calendar/:token

subtasks.description: Add /view-appointment/:token route to src/App.tsx using lazy import and Suspense with PageLoader fallback. Route must be OUTSIDE protected routes (public access).

phases.gateCondition: Navigate to /view-appointment/{token} loads page correctly, invalid token shows error

phases.name: Employer Share Button
phases.description: Add share functionality to employer bookings page

subtasks.description: Modify src/pages/employer/Bookings.tsx to add Share button per appointment row. On click: call appointmentTokens.generate mutation, construct URL, copy to clipboard, show toast with sonner, button shows checkmark icon for 2 seconds then reverts to share icon.
acceptanceCriteria: Share2 icon button added to each appointment
Toast shows 'Link copied!' with 48-hour validity note
Button shows Check icon (green) for 2 seconds after success

phases.gateCondition: Share button visible, clicking copies link to clipboard

phases.name: Browser-CLI E2E Testing
phases.description: Execute 8 test cases covering full patient access flow

subtasks.description: Execute PT-01: Generate magic link from employer portal. Restore authenticated-employer state, navigate to /employer/bookings, click Share button, verify toast appears, capture screenshot.
Execute PT-02: View appointment via valid magic link. Generate token via Convex CLI, navigate to /view-appointment/{token}, verify appointment details displayed, capture screenshot.
Execute PT-03: Invalid token shows error. Navigate to /view-appointment/invalid-token-12345, verify error UI with XCircle icon and 'Link Invalid or Expired' message, capture screenshot.
acceptanceCriteria: Error card with red X icon displayed

subtasks.description: Execute PT-05: Download ICS calendar file. Navigate to valid appointment view, click 'Add to Calendar', verify network request to /calendar/:token succeeds with 200 status, capture screenshot.
Execute PT-06: Mobile responsive layout. Set iPhone 12 viewport, navigate to valid appointment view, verify content readable and buttons accessible, capture screenshot, reset viewport.
Execute PT-07: Zoom link opens correctly. Navigate to appointment with Zoom link, click 'Join Zoom Meeting', verify new tab opens with Zoom URL, capture screenshot.
acceptanceCriteria: Zoom button visible with blue styling
New tab navigates to Zoom URL

subtasks.description: Execute PT-08: Copy link feedback. Restore employer state, click Share button, verify button shows green checkmark temporarily and toast appears, capture screenshot.
acceptanceCriteria: Share button shows checkmark after click
Checkmark reverts to share icon after 2 seconds

subtasks.description: Compile test evidence: Collect all PT-*.png screenshots, create test-results.md summary with pass/fail status for each test, log any issues found.
acceptanceCriteria: All screenshots collected in evidence directory
Any failures documented with repro steps

risks.description: Web Crypto API availability in Convex runtime
risks.mitigation: crypto.subtle.digest is available in Convex - verified in existing codebase patterns
Use URL parsing to extract token from pathname - pattern exists in current http.ts

risks.description: ICS file compatibility across calendar apps
risks.mitigation: Using RFC 5545 standard format with VCALENDAR/VEVENT structure - widely supported
navigator.clipboard.writeText has 95%+ browser support, graceful fallback not critical for admin users
Tokens are UUID v4 (unguessable), SHA-256 hashed in DB, 48hr TTL, single-use option available

notes: Phase 1 must complete before Phase 2 (schema required for types)
Phase 2 tasks can run in parallel (independent files)
Phase 3 depends on both Phase 2 tasks
Phase 4 and 5 can run in parallel after Phase 2.1
Phase 6 tests depend on all implementation phases
Task 6.8 (evidence compilation) runs after all tests
